captured_cases.expected_outcome: Two blind readers retain separately grounded responses and any divergence stays unresolved.
Two blind readers retain separately grounded responses and agreement is explicit.

atomic_step.outcome: Every matrix cell preserves two independent reader seats and exposes agreement, disagreement, no-answer, and ungrounded-defect outcomes without averaging them.
atomic_step.practical_value: A repeated model opinion cannot masquerade as corroboration, and uncertainty remains visible for owner resolution.
atomic_step.stopping_condition: Two real page cases run through distinct reader evidence roots, all five outcome classes remain distinguishable, and unresolved outcomes cannot complete the matrix.

composition.assembly_contract: Use the blind-separated reader state and reducer unchanged.

final_validation.failure_criterion: Reader identity is lost or the stale-page disagreement is reported as complete.
final_validation.operator_path: Open each unchanged page and run read-cell, which launches two isolated Codex processes.
final_validation.success_criterion: The corrected page agrees clear and the stale page exposes its observed disagreement as unresolved.

approaches.hypothesis: One accepted reader response is sufficient for a stable critique cell.
approaches.implementation: Keep the first response as the cell verdict and discard the second identity.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Smaller state, but disagreement becomes invisible.

approaches.hypothesis: Two isolated seats plus a fixed reducer preserve agreement and uncertainty safely.
approaches.implementation: Launch separate readers, retain both grounded responses, and expose five terminal outcomes.
approaches.predicted_tradeoff: Two model calls per cell, with inspectable corroboration and owner-bound uncertainty.

mini_probes.goal: Preserve independent readings and their uncertainty instead of collapsing them.
mini_probes.practical_value: A repeated model opinion cannot masquerade as corroboration, and uncertainty remains visible for owner resolution.

proof.failure_criterion: Either response is overwritten, disagreement completes the matrix, or an outcome collapses into another.
proof.success_criterion: Both real responses retain identity, disagreement stays unresolved, and all five outcomes remain distinct.

winner_output.description: Separate reader state, fixed outcome reducer, and independent model launch path.

mini_probes.work_type_reason: Models read independently; code owns seat identity, outcome reduction, and completion safety.
